articles.title: n8n vs Zapier vs Make: When Paying 10x More Is the Right Call
articles.excerpt: N8N is free and self-hostable. Zapier is $20/month for 750 tasks. Make is $9/month with unlimited operations. If they're solving the same problems, why does anyone pay premium prices? The answer revea…
articles.body: N8N is free and self-hostable. Zapier is $20/month for 750 tasks. Make is $9/month with unlimited operations. If they're solving the same problems, why does anyone pay premium prices? The answer reveals when enterprise features actually matter. Quick Verdict N8N is the choice for technical teams who want full control and can self-host. Zapier wins on reliability and integration count for non-technical teams. Make offers the best balance of price and capability for growing teams. Choose based on your team's technical expertise and reliability requirements, not feature lists. Core Differences The fundamental difference is who each tool targets. N8N assumes you can read logs, debug errors, and handle deployments. Zapier assumes you want zero DevOps.

articles.title: 🧟 Old API Versions: Find the /v1 That Never Died, Then Prove It
articles.excerpt: Teams ship /api/v2, fix the authorization bug that /v1 had, update the docs, and move on. The router never got the memo. /api/v1/orders/1002 still answers, it still talks to the same database, and it…
articles.body: Teams ship /api/v2 , fix the authorization bug that /v1 had, update the docs, and move on. The router never got the memo. /api/v1/orders/1002 still answers, it still talks to the same database, and it still has the bug. That's the whole idea behind OWASP's API9:2023 Improper Inventory Management : you can't secure an API version you've forgotten you run. This post is about finding those forgotten versions and hosts, and then doing the part that matters: proving, with your own test accounts, whether the old door actually skips a check the new one enforces. Only test what you own or are explicitly authorized to test. Everything below uses stand-in hosts ( api.example.com ) and test accounts.

Samsung phones and tablets with Exynos chips have mostly been left in the lurch as a result, resulting in inferior emulation. However, a new custom driver has delivered a major boost.

articles.title: One weight estimator for script types and size hints
articles.excerpt: A coin selector prices an output before anyone tells it what kind of output it is. A caller that tracks script types wants the witness discount to land in the fee; a caller holding nothing but a byte…
articles.body: A coin selector prices an output before anyone tells it what kind of output it is. A caller that tracks script types wants the witness discount to land in the fee; a caller holding nothing but a byte count still wants a number. So you write two fee calculators, one per description, and the two of them disagree by a byte at the edges. A byte at the edges is how you ship a transaction that will not relay. I have been building custodial wallet services and on-chain payment systems since 2018, and fee estimation is the part of that work that rots quietly. It rots because the estimate lives in several places (a selection routine, a dust check, a candidate ranking) and each place rounds a little differently.

articles.title: How to Filter Spam Leads Before They Reach Your CRM
articles.excerpt: A sales team sees 40 new website enquiries on Monday morning. Several are automated submissions, a few are irrelevant pitches, and one valid enquiry is buried in the queue. By the time a representativ…
articles.body: A sales team sees 40 new website enquiries on Monday morning. Several are automated submissions, a few are irrelevant pitches, and one valid enquiry is buried in the queue. By the time a representative finds it, the prospect has already contacted another vendor. Filtering before CRM delivery can reduce that noise. The design challenge is keeping legitimate enquiries recoverable when a rule gets them wrong. Separate form validation from spam detection Validation checks whether the request can be processed. Are the required fields present? Is the message within the supported size? Can the server parse the submission? Spam detection makes a judgment about a request that may pass every validation check. A one-line message from a personal email address could still come from a buyer.

articles.body: WireGuard Portal exposure: external identity is not the same as authorization WireGuard Portal provides a web UI and REST API for managing WireGuard users and interfaces. It supports local authentication plus OIDC, OAuth, passkeys, and LDAP, depending on configuration. That flexibility makes the portal a useful access-management layer, but it also creates a boundary question: does successful authentication from an external provider automatically create a local user with the right access? A ZoomEye count-only probe on 2026-11-11 at 22:43 UTC found 0 for app="WireGuard Portal" and 444 for title="WireGuard Portal" . Both used page 1, page size 1, and sub_type="all" [1]. The title count is a candidate list, not a confirmed deployment count.

articles.title: Your SSL certificate expired. Here is what to do in the next 20 minutes
articles.excerpt: The call usually comes from the client: "The site says it is not secure." Every browser is showing a full-page warning, nobody can get past it, and the shop has been taking zero orders since midnight.…
articles.body: The call usually comes from the client: "The site says it is not secure." Every browser is showing a full-page warning, nobody can get past it, and the shop has been taking zero orders since midnight. An expired certificate is a complete outage with a scary message attached. Here is the order of operations. The first part gets the site back. The second part makes sure you never have this conversation again. Minute 0: confirm it is actually expiry Run this from any machine: echo | openssl s_client -servername example.com -connect example.com:443 2 > /dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -dates -issuer You get notBefore , notAfter and the issuer. If notAfter is in the past, it is expiry.

articles.title: Astronomers stunned after James Webb Space Telescope discovers the earliest pair of black hole-powered quasars
articles.excerpt: Using the James Webb Space Telescope, astronomers have discovered the oldest pair of black hole-powered quasars ever seen. There's just one problem: they shouldn't exist!
articles.body: Using the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), astronomers have discovered the oldest pair of supermassive black hole-powered quasars ever seen. There's just one problem: they shouldn't exist! The compact quasar pair, spotted with the aid of the Gemini North telescope, has been designated J1602+4228AB and nicknamed Nāpōwawāʻenakaulua, which means "Two celestial bodies of fathomless powerful darkness in the brilliance of heat reincarnating energy into the universe." The compact quasar pair is seen as it was 900 million years after the Big Bang at a time when such supermassive black holes should not have had time to grow to such tremendous masses. Nāpōwawāʻenakaulua isn't just the oldest and most distant quasar pairing ever seen.

articles.body: Being Heumann is in theaters now and debuts November 13 on Apple TV. Disability activist Judith Heumann has the perfect name for a story about forcing politicians to acknowledge the humanity of an underclass. More perfect still is the title of her memoir, Being Heumann, which CODA director Sian Heder turns into a straightforward but occasionally rousing biopic revolving around a political sit-in, a film whose authentic casting is a vital part of its form. The board cited “out of context genital nudity” as the sticking point. Rockstar sent an application for a South Korean rating on September 1. The initial vote, held on September 10, ended in a tie, with three votes for classification refusal and three for an Adults Only rating. InvenGlobal acquired the meeting minutes from the voting sessions, where some board members argued for classification refusal over in-game nudity. When voting resulted in a tie, they chose to postpone the decision while awaiting a playable build of the game.

articles.body: SpaceX launched a classified mission for the U.S. Space Force from California tonight (Nov. 11), the second such flight for the company in a six-day span. A Falcon 9 rocket lifted off from California's Vandenberg Space Force Base tonight at 11:36 p.m. EST (8:36 p.m. local California time; 0136 GMT on Nov. 12), kicking off a mission called USSF-627. Vandenberg hosted a similar liftoff less than a week ago: On Nov. 6, a Falcon 9 sent the USSF-432 mission skyward from the site, which lies on California's gorgeous but often foggy central coast. A SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket launches the USSF-627 mission for the U.S. Space Force from California on Nov. 11, 2026. Each day a different image or photograph of our fascinating universe is featured, along with a brief explanation written by a professional astronomer. Moon, Venus and Spica Meet Explanation: Not all those who wander are lost. A night sky example is that planets wander, and in fact the very word “planet” comes from “wandering star” in Greek. As planets shift relative to fixed stars , they may appear from our perspective to get closer to other astronomical objects. Such meetings are called conjunctions . They don’t happen by chance, but follow the precise laws of celestial mechanics .
